name: @earendil-works/design-tokens
description: W3C DTCG design tokens powered by Terrazzo.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:radius && pnpm run build:pi && pnpm run build:earendil && pnpm run build:lefos
scripts.build:radius: rm -rf dist/radius && tz build -c terrazzo.radius.config.ts && tsx scripts/validate-catalogue.ts radius
scripts.build:pi: rm -rf dist/pi && tz build -c terrazzo.pi.config.ts && tsx scripts/validate-catalogue.ts pi
scripts.build:earendil: rm -rf dist/earendil && tz build -c terrazzo.earendil.config.ts && tsx scripts/validate-catalogue.ts earendil
scripts.build:lefos: rm -rf dist/lefos && tz build -c terrazzo.lefos.config.ts && tsx scripts/validate-catalogue.ts lefos
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:types && pnpm run generate:check && pnpm run check:schema && pnpm run check:contrast && pnpm run check:terrazzo
scripts.check:terrazzo: tz check tokens/radius.resolver.json && tz check tokens/pi.resolver.json && tz check tokens/earendil.resolver.json && tz check tokens/lefos.resolver.json
